q: Recently began sleep training and increased baby’s awake time to 10 solid hours and she began sleeping so much better.  It’s only been 4 days doing a modified version of Ferber. I’m honestly exhausted. The lack of sleep is giving me crazy brain fog and I feel like I’m barely functioning.

q: I know it probably is just babies being babies. But there's just no progress which makes me question everything and whether I should be doing something else 🫠

q: Sleep trained my 5 month old and got to a place where she was falling asleep independently for bedtime and naps. […] The we were hit by viral illnesses, sickness bugs (between both my children) and eventually 2 teeth. Now she can't fall asleep independently and wakes multiple times per night.

q: Well, my husband got up for the day and when he asked me how I was doing, I expressed my frustration about the difficulty of the day thus far.
